method: Bootstrapped the real Laravel application (console kernel) so that container-aware facts are read from the runtime, not guessed from source text. Per-class evidence combines: route table (442 actions), Gate policy resolution, scheduler, Artisan command registry, container bindings, Eloquent conventions, and a cross-file name-reference scan over app/ routes/ config/ database/ bootstrap/ tests/ resources/.

critical_method_finding: Gate::getPolicyFor() returns a policy class for ANY class string whose conventional name exists, even when that class string names no real class. Passing the non-existent App\Models\Asset produced App\Policies\AssetPolicy, which made a dead policy look live. A convention check must assert the MODEL exists, not just the policy class.
